records.question: What could I use CMS HCRIS hospital cost reports for?
records.human_summary: Use HCRIS as a primary facility/provider-period source for longitudinal hospital financial, cost-center, charge, settlement, capacity, and utilization analysis.
records.agent_summary: Recommend for provider-period hospital financial and utilization questions; require release-year alignment and do not describe facility filings as consolidated health-system accounts.

measures.label: Hospital financial-statement fields
measures.notes: The frozen source description asserts financial-statement fields; exact worksheets and variables require release-specific inspection.

measures.label: Cost-center and charge fields
measures.notes: Treat charges, costs, and cost-center amounts according to the selected HCRIS form and release documentation.

measures.label: Utilization and hospital-capacity fields
measures.notes: Availability is source-asserted at the family level and must be verified in the selected file layout.

compatible_units.notes: The source truth identifies hospital/provider-period reports.
Facility-level interpretation is supported when the selected report and CCN context are retained.
Provider-period is the source-native analytical grain described by the fixture.
Do not infer consolidated parent-system finance without an explicit, versioned consolidation method and evidence-bound crosswalk.

requirements: Join a versioned rural classification using a documented geography or facility identifier; HCRIS does not make rurality direct in this fixture.

alignment_requirements: Align fiscal/report periods rather than assuming calendar-year equivalence.
Retain amended or repeated reports as versioned records.

requirements: Normalize to the documented six-character CCN representation.
Version both releases and align report periods to directory snapshots.
limitations: CCN continuity does not prove continuous ownership or health-system identity.
Join guidance is candidate compatibility, not an identity merge.

evidence.claim: The frozen source description lists provider-period financial, cost-center, charge, settlement, utilization, and capacity fields.
limitations: No live file layout or payload was inspected in this package.

evidence.claim: The frozen source record asserts national coverage and derivable rather than direct rurality support.
limitations: The completeness of national coverage was not re-tested.

evidence.claim: The frozen source record describes annual releases spanning 1996 through 2026.
limitations: Older extracts may be subsets and electronic representation is not guaranteed for every submission.
This is an analytical-fit assertion, not source truth.
No current endpoint, payload, worksheet, variable, or completeness review occurred.
HCRIS facility filings are not consolidated parent-system financial statements.

records.question: What could I use PHC4 public hospital financial reports for?
records.human_summary: Use PHC4 public reports for Pennsylvania report-level hospital and health-system financial-condition, utilization, and annual trend review when publication-level evidence is sufficient.
records.agent_summary: Return this route for Pennsylvania public financial-report questions, but label it publication-level and do not imply open record-level data or access to PHC4 custom files.

measures.label: Published financial-condition measures
measures.notes: Measures are available as presented in specific annual HTML or PDF publications; preserve the report definition and year.

measures.label: Published utilization measures
measures.notes: Do not assume a stable row-level table across report years.

compatible_units.notes: Hospital is source-asserted as a report unit.
System-level use is conditional on the definitions and groupings printed in the selected report year.
State-level summaries may be used only as published, without treating them as record-level microdata.

requirements: Preserve report-year facility labels and use an independently documented rural crosswalk if rural stratification is needed.

alignment_requirements: Retain the exact report year and publication definition.
Do not assume facility or system definitions are stable across years.

requirements: Obtain a report-specific facility table or documented PHC4 label-to-CCN crosswalk before joining.
limitations: Publication labels are not CCNs.
Public report pages and PDFs are not proven row-level datasets.

evidence.claim: The frozen source description identifies public Pennsylvania hospital and health-system financial-condition, utilization, and annual financial publications.
limitations: No publication payload or current page was opened in this package.

evidence.claim: The frozen source record limits this asset to Pennsylvania and marks rurality as derivable.
limitations: No rural crosswalk is included.

evidence.claim: The frozen source record describes annual public reports from 1996 through 2024.
limitations: Publication coverage and definitions may vary by year.
This Use Card does not convert publication pages into a record-level dataset.
Public report access does not imply access to custom PHC4 data.
Current URLs and publication inventory were not live verified.

records.question: What could I use a PHC4 custom data request for?
records.human_summary: Consider the custom route for Pennsylvania record-level or bespoke analyses whose required variables and grain are not available in public reports, subject to application, review, quote, payment, permitted-use, and transfer terms.
records.agent_summary: Surface this route only as conditional access: ask the user to define variables, grain, period, purpose, approvals, and budget; never represent application eligibility as acquired data.

measures.label: Request-defined variables
measures.notes: Availability, definitions, cost, and permitted use require human confirmation with PHC4.

measures.label: Potential record-level events
